drafted_from: tool:check-the-x-connection's row in tools/connect-a-service-and-seal-its-key/tool-rows.json (job, description: the X "who am I" call returns data.id and data.username) and sign-in-settings.json (the connect tool runs it as the x verify step); the folder test has no stand-in for X's answer, so the reply is the shape the row's description gives, with made-up values
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that my X connection service_connection:x:sams_bakery still works and tell me which account it is." It runs tool:check-the-x-connection and names the X account the sign-in reaches, changing nothing.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it asks X one read-only question for the connection it is handed and answers X's reply.
instructions: 1. Connect X first if you have not: tool:connect-an-account-by-signing-in-to-the-service with service x gives the connection id (service_connection:x or service_connection:x:<account>).
2. Say to your AI: "Check my X connection <that id>". It calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:check-the-x-connection and {account_id: <that id>}.
3. Read what comes back: data.id and data.username of the X account the sign-in reaches. The access token is placed from the vault as the request leaves and is never shown.
4. If X refuses (an expired or revoked sign-in), connect X again; this tool changes nothing either way.

worked_examples.title: Check a made-up X connection
worked_examples.ask: Check that my X connection service_connection:x:sams_bakery still works.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/connect-a-service-and-seal-its-key/tool-rows.json: the row sends the X "who am I" request (api.x.com version 2, users, me) with the connection's held access token and answers X's reply as it is (result_selector $). Input: {"account_id":"service_connection:x:sams_bakery"}; the account is made up.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"data":{"id":"2244994945","name":"Sam's Bakery","username":"sams_bakery"}}: the connection still reaches the X account sams_bakery. A refused answer would mean connect X again.
